items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Even when he was with Basie and I was with Barnet, I'd still go out with him every night.

ctx.x: Well, that was nice. Whoever thought of that was nice. I like people that think of nice things to do for other people.

Yeah, well, he was something else. But he sounded so beautiful, man, I don't know how anybody wouldn't want to do something for him, man. I remember I used to love to go... I used to go and hear that sound that was coming out of Minton's when Charlie would be there playing. Prez, too. I had to go out with Prez damn near every night. Even when he was with Basie and I was with Barnet, I'd still go out with him every night. Because he just sounded so good, man.
You just wanted to be around that sound.
